"""Preserve the ongoing study; an archive is not a promotion decision."""
import base64,datetime,gzip,hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess,tempfile
root=pathlib.Path('/tmp/engine-under10k-20261103')
repo=pathlib.Path('/home/holo/line')
sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def textfile(p):
 b=p.read_bytes();return {'sha256':sha(b),'text':b.decode()}
def blob(p):
 b=p.read_bytes();return {'sha256':sha(b),'bytes':len(b),'gzipBase64':base64.b64encode(gzip.compress(b,mtime=0)).decode()}
runs={}
for p in sorted(root.glob('*/result.json')):
 d=json.loads(p.read_text())
 if d.get('schema')=='line.engine-ab.v1' and d.get('complete'):runs[p.parent.name]=d
files={}
for p in sorted(root.iterdir()):
 if p.is_file() and p.suffix in {'.txt','.json','.log','.mts','.py','.ts','.rs','.patch'}:
  files[p.name]=textfile(p)
# Keep instrumentation, identities, and raw profiles outside copied worktrees.
for pattern in ['*-validation/identity.json','*-reference/identity.json','profile*/*.json','profile*/*.mts',
                '*-counts*/counts.json','*-counts*/protocol.json','*-counts*/instrumented-*']:
 for p in sorted(root.glob(pattern)):
  if p.is_file():files[str(p.relative_to(root))]=textfile(p)
profiles={str(p.relative_to(root)):blob(p) for p in sorted(root.glob('profile*/*.cpuprofile'))}
binaries={p.name:blob(p) for p in sorted(root.glob('*.wasm'))}
patch=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','HEAD','--','.',':!scripts/lib/native_motion/engine.wasm',':!docs/research/engine-under7k-20261103.json'],cwd=repo)
working_patch=patch
patch=(root/'milestone-validation.patch').read_bytes()
identity=json.loads((root/'milestone-validation/identity.json').read_text())
qualification=json.loads((root/'milestone-qualification.json').read_text()) if (root/'milestone-qualification.json').exists() else None
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='archive-source-',dir=root) as scratch:
 code="import {snapshotSources,sourceOverlay} from '/home/holo/line/tools/measure/engine_sources.ts';const [source,out]=process.argv.slice(1);snapshotSources(source,out,source);process.stdout.write(sourceOverlay(out,out).sourceSha256[1]);"
 actual=subprocess.check_output(['node','--import','tsx','--input-type=module','-e',code,str(root/'milestone-validation/worktree'),scratch],cwd=repo,text=True)
 assert actual==identity['sourceSha256'], 'Frozen validated source identity changed' 
archive={
 'schema':'line.engine-optimization-study.v1',
 'updatedUtc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 'status':'qualified milestone; 7000 ns target remains unmet' if qualification and qualification.get('adoptMilestone') else 'in-progress; no final promotion or target-completion claim',
 'qualification':qualification,
 'branch':subprocess.check_output(['git','branch','--show-current'],cwd=repo,text=True).strip(),
 'baseline':'421c0e81 (production sources unchanged from 265545b6)',
 'target':{'workload':'full default automatic compilation, parity cell 61','unit':'ns per charged physics frame',
   'threshold':7000,'required':'fresh qualified 24-pair confirmation; candidate mean and upper 95% bootstrap mean bound below threshold; exact track/work parity and declared guards',
   'satisfied':False},
 'currentCheckpoint':{'identity':identity,'wasm':blob(root/'milestone.wasm'),
   'patch':patch.decode(),'patchSha256':sha(patch),'note':'Frozen structural checkpoint including batch-local history reuse. Fresh validation is recorded in milestone-checks.json; promotion and the absolute target are separate decisions. Staged files are included in its saved patch.'},
 'workingPrototype':{'patch':working_patch.decode(),'patchSha256':sha(working_patch),'wasm':blob(repo/'scripts/lib/native_motion/engine.wasm'),'note':'In progress; this separate identity does not inherit the checkpoint validation or imply promotion.'},
 'interpretation':[
   'Screens through frame-chunks compare cumulative candidates against the original baseline. Their KEEP verdicts do not establish incremental improvements over the preceding candidate.',
   'Remaining trials use direct frozen development references as predeclared in plan.txt; final promotion is separate.',
   'No scoring, search budget, physics equations, charge denominator, Node flags or CPU governor were changed to satisfy the target.',
   'WASM high-water measurements describe linear-memory growth, not live allocations or process RSS.',
   'The initial geometry-reuse diagnostic exhausted its heap because the diagnostic key accidentally serialized loaded models. It is invalid; the narrowed-input diagnostic completed exactly.',
   'The pre-existing missing audio fixture in eval_evidence.test.ts remains a known repository test failure.',
   'Bootstrap support is fixed-sample performance evidence, not a posterior probability or an anytime-valid stopping rule.',
 ],
 'runs':runs,'binaryArtifacts':binaries,'rawProfiles':profiles,'studyFiles':files,
}
out=repo/'docs/research/engine-under7k-20261103.json'
out.write_text(json.dumps(archive,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'archive':str(out),'bytes':out.stat().st_size,'completeRuns':len(runs),'files':len(files),'profiles':len(profiles),'binaries':len(binaries),'targetSatisfied':False}))

ids[i * 3 + 1] = l.type;\n    ids[i * 3 + 2] = (l.flipped ? 1 : 0) | (l.leftExtended ? 2 : 0) | (l.rightExtended ? 4 : 0);\n    coords[i * 4] = l.x1; coords[i * 4 + 1] = l.y1;\n    coords[i * 4 + 2] = l.x2; coords[i * 4 + 3] = l.y2;\n  });\n  return ex.add_lines(handle, lines.length);\n}\nfunction add(ex: Exports, handle: number, lines: any[]) {\n  for (let start = 0; start < lines.length; start += ex.add_lines_cap()) {\n    const next = addBatch(ex, handle, lines.slice(start, start + ex.add_lines_cap()));\n    ex.free_engine(handle);\n    handle = next;\n  }\n  return handle;\n}\nfunction start(ex: Exports, track: any) {\n  const root = ex.create_engine(), p = track.startPosition, v = track.riders[0].startVelocity;\n  const handle = ex.set_start(root, p.x, p.y, v.x, v.y);\n  ex.free_engine(root);\n  return handle;\n}\nexport type Workload = 'register' | 'replay' | 'branches';\nexport function run(ex: Exports, workload: Workload, verify = false) {\n  const digest = createHash('sha256');\n  let frames = 0, stepMs = 0;\n  const observe = (h: number, f: number) => {\n    const before = ex.get_last_frame_index(h);\n    frames += Math.max(0, f - before);\n    ex.get_state_map(h, f);\n    if (verify) {\n      digest.update(String(before));\n      digest.update(new Uint8Array(ex.memory.buffer, ex.scratch_ptr(), 84 * 8));\n      const count = ex.get_updates(h, f);\n      digest.update(String(count));\n      digest.update(new Uint8Array(ex.memory.buffer, ex.events_ptr(), count * 3 * 8));\n      const contacts = ex.get_contact_positions(h, f, f);\n      assert(contacts >= 0);\n      digest.update(String(contacts));\n      digest.update(new Uint8Array(ex.memory.buffer, ex.contact_positions_ptr(), contacts * 3 * 8));\n    }\n  };\n  for (const {track} of tracks) {\n    let root = start(ex, track);\n    if (workload !== 'branches') {\n      root = add(ex, root, track.lines);\n      ex.get_last_frame_index(root); // forces registration, even without stepping\n      if (workload === 'replay') {\n        if (verify) for (let f = 0; f <= track.duration; f++) observe(root, f);\n        else { const started = performance.now(); observe(root, track.duration); stepMs += performance.now() - started; }\n      }\n    } else {\n      // Sibling versions add real track suffixes; switching back forces removal,\n      // invalidation, lazy history materialization, and re-simulation.\n      const split = Math.min(100, track.lines.length);\n      root = add(ex, root, track.lines.slice(0, split));\n      observe(root, 120);\n      for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {\n        const branch = addBatch(ex, root, [{id: 1000000 + i, type: i % 2, x1: -50, y1: 20 + i, x2: 350, y2: 40 + i}]);\n        const child = add(ex, branch, track.lines.slice(split, split + 100 + i * 20));\n        observe(child, 180);\n        if (verify) for (let f = 0; f <= 180; f++) observe(child, f);\n        ex.free_engine(child);\n        observe(root, 120);\n      }\n      // A detached prefix must not retain pointers into its source grid.\n      const detached = ex.detach_engine(root);\n      ex.free_engine(root);\n      root = detached;\n      observe(root, 200);\n    }\n    ex.free_engine(root);\n  }\n  return {stepMs, frames, fingerprint: verify ? digest.digest('hex') : null};\n}\nexport const workloads: Workload[] = ['register', 'replay', 'branches'];\n",
